name: v2.5.21-dev.115
body:
## What's new in v2.5.21-dev.115

- chore(flasher): make-selfextract.sh eseguibile, come su svil
- feat: drop the macOS build and send Mac users to balenaEtcher
- fix(flasher): read drive flags from the entry, not from the wrapper hiding them
- fix(flasher): the writability probe test assumed a POSIX filesystem
- feat(flasher): skip elevation when the drive is already writable
- feat(flasher): allow disk images as targets, behind an explicit opt-in
- fix(flasher): say what macOS actually refused instead of blaming the stick
- fix(website): the download button now really disappears when macOS is selected
- fix(flasher): stop offering system disks, whatever drivelist claims about them
- fix(website): repair the broken script that left every download button dead
- fix(website): move the LyrPlay recommendation to the beta site, with a QR code
- feat(website): macOS gets two Terminal commands instead of a download button
- docs(website): recommend LyrPlay for iPhone and iPad, clearly as a third party
- feat(website): macOS is back, downloaded from Terminal so it is never quarantined
- feat(website): drop the macOS builds from the download options for now
- fix(website): the macOS note described a button that never appears
- fix(flasher): ad-hoc sign the macOS build instead of not signing it at all
- fix(flasher): stop the image cache growing by a gigabyte per release
- feat(website): lead with the app, keep the ISO as the fallback, explain the gate
- fix(website): say the app is unsigned without making anyone click for it
- feat(website): choose the ISO or the app for your OS from a dropdown
- fix(flasher): write the partition table last, and give the disk a signature
- fix(flasher): restore mode never reached restore(), and the Linux wrap could not run
- fix(flasher): report what the elevated helper said, not what the shell made of it
- fix(ci): the Intel macOS job needs macos-15-intel, not macos-15
- feat(flasher): restore a stick to factory condition
- fix(flasher): Secure Boot is a required step, and the stick comes out after the reboot
- feat(flasher): give the app its own icon, derived from the project logo
- chore(flasher): drop the two fixable advisories, document the rest
- feat(flasher): guide the whole install, not just the USB stick
- feat(flasher): Linux ships as a single self-extracting executable
- fix(flasher): the write test runs on macOS and Windows too
- fix(flasher): stop the elevated helper aborting on Electron's buffer limits
- fix(flasher): the over-256-GB warning no longer shows on every drive
- fix(flasher): pin usb to 3.x so the native rebuild stops failing
- fix(flasher): the test suite no longer needs the production signing key
- fix(ci): the flasher build no longer dies when the version is unchanged
- feat(flasher): Osmium Flasher writes the installer ISO to a USB stick
